title: How he got the name Kid Sheik: arrow suits
summary: Asked his real and musical names, he explains he dressed in Sheik-style suits with arrows and uptown pockets.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah, okay. I just want to know your name first. What is it in here? George Kohler. For truth? That's your real name, no? Real name. And what's your other name? Your musical name? Sheik. Kid Sheik. How come they called you that in here?
I just used to dress in the Sheik clothes. I bought them suits with the arrows all around it. Arrows? Yeah, arrows on the back of the coat, side of the coat, pockets.
Made with thread? Sort of decorated with thread or something else sewed on them? How are you?
